/api/reviews.title: Precise and quiet
/api/reviews.body: The gooseneck gives real control and it heats faster than my old one.

/api/reviews.title: Handle gets warm
/api/reviews.body: Great pour, but the handle warms up after a second boil.

/api/reviews.title: Worth the upgrade
/api/reviews.body: Temperature hold works as described. Looks good on the counter.

/api/reviews.title: Lid is a bit loose
/api/reviews.body: Does the job well. The lid could fit tighter.
